title: uxc tag-class delta (fd/tagclass-deltas/<Tag>.delta.json)
description: Values an extension adds to a CHOICELIST tag class it does not own (fd.tagclass-delta, DESIGN §28). Push merges by symbolicName and never removes a product value. Every value must carry the package's UPPER prefix (checked by uxc verify: EXT_TAG_VALUE_PREFIX).

$schema.description: Editor hint only: uxc ignores it.

tagclass.description: Target tag class id; must equal the file name (<Tag>.delta.json) and the registry id.

legacy.description: Unprefixed values (e.g. "ORDER") the extension inherited under their old codes: exempt from the prefix check. A declaration never makes a value removable: rm --server removes one only if this package's push added it to the server. Each must also be listed in allowedValues; uxc keeps this key across push/pull rewrites (not hashed).

symbolicName.description: UPPER_SNAKE value name, starting with the package's UPPER prefix (e.g. "ACME_ESCALATION").

displayNames.description: Labels, EN and FR by convention.
